pr_body:
swc_ecma_parser:
 - Accept `export type * from '../typings'` (Closes #896)

swc_ecma_transforms:
 - Ensure that swc does not duplicate classes (Closes #879)

issue_context.title: Property decorators shouldn't duplicate class
comments: Okay, so this seems to be a bug in the inliner instead. Setting `optimization: None` makes it work closer to how TSC works.

review_comments:
@kdy1 I think I might have accidentally given you invalid config in the issue #879, since this one doesn't even seem to enable optimizations if I read the code correctly (`optimizer` would default to `None` as is defined at https://github.com/swc-project/swc/blob/master/src/config.rs#L572)

I tested HEAD transpiler locally, and this issue still seems to happen, although my transpiler config is not the same as it was in the issue anymore.
Nice. Really appreciate all the work and active effort you put in
